info.title: Runlight 0.1.1, privacy friendly web analytics for any number of sites.
info.description: The Runlight server as a .NET tool: runlight serve runs privacy friendly web analytics for any number of sites on SQLite, Postgres, MySQL, or MariaDB.

commands.name: agents
commands.description: Count AI agents from a web server's access log

options.name: --log
options.description: The access log, in nginx or Apache's combined format, or Caddy's JSON

options.name: --to
options.description: Your Runlight, as its dashboard address (or RUNLIGHT_URL)

options.name: --key
options.description: The site's key from Settings, Install, Key for CMS plugins (or RUNLIGHT_OBSERVE_KEY)

options.name: --site
options.description: The site's address, such as https://example.com, when the log has no host in it

options.name: --follow
options.description: Keep running and send fetches as they happen

options.name: --state
options.description:
Remember where it stopped, so the next run, or a restarted --follow, starts there.
Only one run at a time can use it.

commands.name: cron
commands.description: Run the scheduled check, and fetch this month's location data

commands.name: password
commands.description: Make an account, or give one a new password

commands.name: setup
commands.description: Print the link that makes the first account
